name: State Propagation Rule
applies_when: Election A updates state field X, and election B reads field X

name: Parent Reference Rule
applies_when: Election B explicitly lists A as parent_election

name: Temporal Sequence Rule
applies_when: Elections A and B modify same state domain, A happens before B, close in time

name: Coherence Influence Rule
applies_when: A's outcome affects coherence metric that determines B's choice

name: Utility Maximization
description: ARIA tends to choose options with higher utility scores
